programs.title: Would I Lie To You?
programs.sub_title: James Acaster, Gabby Logan, Melvin Odoom & Fay Ripley
programs.desc: Rob Brydon hosts the award-winning comedy panel show with David Mitchell and Lee Mack as the lightning-quick team captains. Over the course of the show, celebrity guests reveal amazing stories about themselves, some of which are true and some of which are not. The aim of the game is to fool the opposition into mistaking fact for fiction and fiction for fact. The guests on this episode are James Acaster, Gabby Logan, Melvin Odoom and Fay Ripley.

programs.title: Mythbusters
programs.desc: Not so long ago, in a work-shop not so far, far away, a band of rebel scientists, striking from a hidden base in San Francisco tested 3 Star Wars myths and restored common sense to the galaxy!

programs.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent Down Under
programs.desc: Today's mission takes Phil to Perth in Western Australia. But being down under has never been so challenging, as he tries to help a party girl who's extremely hard to satisfy.

programs.title: Grand Designs UK
programs.desc: After 15 years of saving and planning, Fred and Saffron Baker start work on their innovative new family home on a 30 degree slope. Kevin McCloud visits the Peak District as they build into the thick Derbyshire limestone.

programs.title: Claire Hooper's House Of Games
programs.desc: Dropping by Claire Hooper's House of Games this week, we've got ABC's Costa Georgiadis, podcaster Jessie Stephens, and comedians Gillian Cosgriff and Rhys Nicholson discovering who has the smarts to win a salad spinner.
